impact: Auto-capture is `git diff HEAD` only, so reviewing a branch or a landed commit requires pasting the diff or staging it into a scratch worktree; on a shared machine the CPM team's worktree workaround caused an unrelated incident. `src/utils/git.ts` already supports diff between refs; expose it as `base` / `head` (or `commit`) on review_code and the CLI. Also relevant to the care2talk "bridge review pending" outage workflow, which retroactively reviews landed commits.
resolution: Commit 5661197. review_code accepts base (and optional head, default HEAD) and runs git diff base head at the repository root of cwd; CLI review-code gains --base/--head and --diff is no longer required. Refs validated by GitRefSchema (same pattern as git.ts, leading '-' refused), range cannot combine with an explicit diff, empty range answers without a reviewer via NO_RANGE_CHANGES.
title: review_code cannot review a committed range: add base/head ref pair or commit argument instead of forcing a pasted diff or scratch worktree
